PRESS                              
RELEASE  
 
TVS Motor Company's Q2 Sales Grow by 27% 
• International Business sales grew by 35% at 539K units; two-wheeler EVs sales grew by 
133% at 186K units in Q2 FY 27 
• September 2026 sales up by 24% at 673K units 
  
Bengaluru, October 01, 2026:  TVS Motor Company (TVSM),  part of TVS VENU,  registered 
quarterly sales of 1.9 million units during the second quarter of the FY  2026-27. Two-wheelers 
registered a growth of 27% with sales of 1.8 million units in the second quarter of FY 2026-27 as 
against 1.5 million units in t he second quarter of FY 2025-26. Three -wheelers registered a 
growth of 47% with sales of 78,475 units in the second quarter of FY 2026-27 as against 53,449 
units in the second quarter of FY 2025- 26. Total international Business registered a growth of 
35% with sales of 0.5 million units in the second quarter of FY 2026-27 as against 0.4 million 
units in the second quarter of FY 2025-26.  
 
Sales Performance September 2026 
TVS Motor Company recorded 24% increase in sales with 672,790 units in September 2026 as 
against 541,064 units in September 2025. 
 
Two-Wheeler 
Total two-wheelers registered a growth of 23% with sales  of 645,955 units in September 2026 
as against 523,923  units in September  2025. Domestic two -wheelers registered growth 
of 17% with sales of 482,073 units in September  2026 as against 413,279 units in September  
2025. 
 
Electric Vehicle 
Two-wheeler EVs registered 110% increase in sales with 65,799 units in September 2026 as 
against 31,266 units in September 2025. 
International Business 
Total International Business sales grew by 48% with sales of 180,700 units in September 2026 
as against 122,108 units in September 2025. Two-wheelers sales registered  a growth of 48% 
with sales of 163,882 units in September 2026 as against 110,644 units in September 2025.  
Three-Wheeler 
Three-wheelers registered a growth of 57 % with sales of 26,835 units in September 2026 as 
against 17,141 units in September 2025.

About TVS Motor Company 
TVS Motor Company (BSE:532343 and NSE: TVSMOTOR),  part of TVS VENU, is a repu ted 
two and three -wheeler manufacturer globally, championing progress through sustainable 
mobility with four state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities located in India and Indonesia. Rooted 
in our 100- year legacy of trust, value, and passion for customers, it takes pride in making 
internationally accepted products of the highest quality through innovative and sustainable 
processes. TVS Motor is the only two- wheeler company to have won the prestigious Deming 
Prize. Our products lead in their respective categories in the J.D. Power IQS and APEAL 
surveys. We have been ranked No. 1 Company in the J.D. Power Customer Service 
Satisfaction Survey for four consecutive years. Our group company Norton Motorcycles, based 
in the United Kingdom, is one of the most emotive motorcycle brands in the world. TVS Motor 
Company endeavours to deliver the most superior customer experience across 90 countries in 
which we operate.  
For more information, please visit www.tvsmotor.com
